title: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态任务中表现出色，但仍然容易出现对象幻觉——即生成语言上流畅但缺乏视觉依据的答案。这一问题在低资源语言中尤为严重，因为较弱的跨模态对齐使得模型更依赖语言先验而非图像证据。现有的解决方案要么需要昂贵的多语言标注或外部翻译/奖励模型，要么在推理阶段进行干预，从而可能扭曲输出语言。我们提出了VEPO（视觉证据引导的偏好优化），这是一种训练时方法，无需外部模型即可将可靠的视觉定位能力从英语迁移到其他语言。VEPO首先通过中层跨模态注意力机制使用英语查询定位关键视觉证据，然后构建共享相同正确答案但证据充分性不同的偏好对（完整图像 vs. k...（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出VEPO训练时方法，利用英语查询定位视觉证据并构建证据充分性不同的偏好对进行偏好优化，无需外部模型即可将可靠的视觉定位能力从英语迁移到其他语言，有效缓解大型视觉语言模型在多语言（尤其是低资源语言）场景下的对象幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: VEPO is a training-time preference optimization method that uses English queries to localize visual evidence and constructs preference pairs differing in evidence sufficiency, transferring reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models to mitigate multilingual object hallucinations in LVLMs.
